OverviewIntro: One place to keep everything on this PC current: apps, Windows, drivers, Python packages, and the manual updates that need a guided hand. Pick a card below to jump straight to it.
OverviewTipProgramsBody: Scans installed apps via winget and updates the ones with a newer version.
OverviewTipWindowsUpdatesBody: Checks Windows Update for pending OS and security patches.
OverviewTipDriversBody: Finds outdated hardware drivers offered through Windows Update.
OverviewTipPipPackagesBody: Lists outdated pip packages and upgrades them with one click.
OverviewTipGuidesBody: For updates no tool can automate — GPU drivers, Visual Studio — a step-by-step guide opens the right official tool and verifies completion for real.
GuidesWhatTitle: Some updates can't be automated — this is where you handle them
GuidesWhatBody: GPU drivers, BIOS/firmware, and a handful of dev tools don't ship through Windows Update or winget, so XenUpdate can't silently install them for you. Instead, pick one below: it opens the right official tool and walks you through the exact steps, then checks for itself whether it's done — no self-reporting, no guessing.
